title: subagent: Find year alligator first found west of Texas

content:
I need to answer this question: "According to the USGS, in what year was the American Alligator first found west of Texas (not including Texas)?"

Please search the internet using any method available to you. Try:
1. Search for USGS American alligator range/distribution data
2. Search for "American alligator" "first found" "west of Texas" 
3. Search for American alligator historical range New Mexico Arizona
4. Try visiting USGS.gov pages about alligators
5. Try visiting Wikipedia's American alligator page
6. Try searching for "Alligator mississippiensis" range expansion west Texas

I need to find the specific year. Report back what year it was and what source/USGS document mentions this.
